title: Light-filled chapter
description: A chapter card: a giant serif number is filled from below by a mask of gold light over its own outline, the title rises word by word, a gold line draws across the whole width, and the camera keeps pushing in slowly.

props.title: required, the chapter name, 1-6 words
props.number: the chapter number shown large, for example 02
props.gold: words of the title to colour gold
